intro: Czechs are known for their love of beer, hiking, puppets and dark humour, and Czechia is one of the least religious countries in the world.

chapters.title: People and language
text: Prague is the capital and largest city, followed by Brno and Ostrava. Czech is a West Slavic language famous for the sound written ř, found in almost no other language.
Most Czechs say they have no religion. Many families own a small country cottage where they spend weekends, and hiking is a national hobby, with tens of thousands of kilometres of marked trails.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: Czechs drink more beer per person than any other nation. At Christmas many families keep a live carp in the bathtub before cooking it for Christmas Eve dinner.

keyTerms.meaning: A family of languages including Czech, Polish and Russian.
